page_title: BRE 2-1 CRY | Brentford v Crystal Palace 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' Samuel Barrott shows a yellow card to Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Bryan Mbeumo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ben Mee (Brentford).

89' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Mark Flekken anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the left side of the target.
87' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) blows a big chance from close range. World class save by the goalkeeper.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chris Richards trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace).
84' Substitution. Will Hughes walks off the pitch and Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.
84' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Mathias Jensen and he is replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) is replacing Yoane Wissa.
83' The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace win a corner kick.
83' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

82' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) gets inside the box and tries to beat Mark Flekken with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Crystal Palace earn a corner.

82' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Samuel Barrott no option but to blow his whistle. Brentford are awarded a free kick.
80' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
76' 2 - 1 Goal! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:1.
76' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
74' Oliver Glasner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) replacing Adam Wharton.
74' Substitution. Vitaly Janelt makes his way off the pitch and Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) comes on as his replacement.
74' Here is a change. Kevin Schade is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).

72' It looks like Christian Norgaard (Brentford) saw red with that tackle. Samuel Barrott won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Crystal Palace have been awarded a free kick.
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) coming on for Daichi Kamada.
66' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
65' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Samuel Barrott didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
65' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

65' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Mark Flekken thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

64' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Crystal Palace can continue in their attacking effort.
64' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) takes the corner with a short pass.
61' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle after Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Crystal Palace get a free kick.
60' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) has a goal ruled out for offside!
58' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
56' 1 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him, it's into his own goal!
53' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Mark Flekken makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
53' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
53' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) will take a corner kick.
51' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes it short.
50' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
49' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) prepares to take a corner kick.
48' Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Dean Henderson.
48' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
47' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes a short corner kick.
46' Oliver Glasner has made a change at the break. Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) has come on in place of Jean-Philippe Mateta.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Samuel Barrott has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' The resulting corner, taken by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace), comes to nothing.
45+2' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Barrott had an easy-decision to make.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Kevin Schade (Brentford) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
40' Kevin Schade (Brentford) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
40' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) dribbles into the box, but Mark Flekken is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
40' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) makes a strong challenge and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
39' Kevin Schade (Brentford) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Crystal Palace win a free kick.
35' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Samuel Barrott has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick to Brentford.
31' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Dean Henderson pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
29' 1 - 0 Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the left post.
27' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace).

27' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Samuel Barrott blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Crystal Palace, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
27' It seemed like Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
25' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Mark Flekken has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
25' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
22' The foul by Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Samuel Barrott.
22' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
21' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position, just outside the box.
20' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) sees a yellow card from Samuel Barrott after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
17' The game is interrupted. Mathias Jensen (Brentford) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
17' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Samuel Barrott signals. A free kick has been awarded to Brentford.
16' Samuel Barrott blows the whistle, Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul. Brentford will take a free kick near the side line.
12' Dangerous play by Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace). Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. Brentford are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
9' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
6' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mark Flekken intercepts the ball.
6' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) takes the corner which is cleared.
2' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
2' Kevin Schade (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Brentford have a corner.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Crystal Palace will take the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott will referee today's match.
